how_to_label: Replace every null under "labels" with "pass" or "fail", judging the reply only. Add anything worth knowing to "notes".

questions.language-consistency: Is the reply entirely in the required language? Names and addresses don't count.
questions.grounded: Is every fact in the reply supported by the conversation, the tool results or the dates?
questions.task-success: Does the reply do what the expected behaviour describes, with the right facts? Answering the question with a wrong answer is a fail.
questions.phone-style: 1-3 short sentences, at most one question, no lists or ids, times said the way people speak, and 2-3 times when offering?
questions.availability-correct: Are the offered times real open slots that match the request? If none match, does the reply say so?
